Workstation with an Intel client processor and three discrete GPUs on older drivers or in runtime suspend: an AMD card whose firmware reports only power1_input, suspended; an Intel card on xe with the single unlabeled energy1_input of Linux 6.8 and 6.9; and an Intel card on i915 with the device counter only, suspended. Attributes follow the driver sources named in workstation-gpus-new. Values are arbitrary.
